name: API Changelog
description: A versioned changelog entry: what changed in the interface contract, and whether it breaks compatibility.
prompt_template:
You are writing a api changelog for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: version, breaking_changes, additions, fixes, migration.
